envelope.description: Add CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError and catch-translate it in readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch

body.title: Add CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError and catch-translate it in readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch
body.summary: Export a new `CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError extends Error` class carrying `serverName`. Wrap the existing `this.runCodex(codexReadOnlySessionArgs(...), ...)` call inside readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch (cli-provider.ts:741) in a try/catch: on catch, read `err instanceof CliExitError ? err.said : (err as Error).message`, match it against codex's live-confirmed bootstrap-rejection pattern ('Error loading config.toml: invalid transport in `mcp_servers.<name>`'); on a match throw `CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError(name)` with the extracted server name, else re-throw the original error unchanged. No other step in readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch (walkProjectMcpConfigLayers, schema temp file, discoverCodexMcpServers, budget recompute, codexReadOnlySessionArgs, reply parsing) is reordered or modified.
acceptanceChecks: CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError is exported from cli-provider.ts with a readonly serverName field
readOnlySessionOnce's codex branch catches a runCodex failure and translates it per the pattern match, with every other step in the branch unchanged in order and behavior
a failure that does not match the pattern is re-thrown exactly as before (same type, same message)

tests.name: readOnlySessionOnce throws CodexMcpServerOverrideUnsafeError('codex_app') when runCodex's failure message matches codex's live-confirmed bootstrap-rejection wording naming codex_app
